concepts.name: concept
concepts.description: A target category or class that the learner is trying to identify.

concepts.name: hypothesis
concepts.description: A candidate description of the target concept.

concepts.name: example
concepts.description: A labeled training instance that is either positive or negative for the target concept.

concepts.name: positiveExample
concepts.description: An example that should be covered by the learned concept.

concepts.name: negativeExample
concepts.description: An example that should not be covered by the learned concept.

concepts.name: specificBoundary
concepts.description: The most specific hypothesis that remains possible after processing the examples.

concepts.name: generalBoundary
concepts.description: The most general hypothesis that remains possible after processing the examples.

concepts.name: versionSpace
concepts.description: The set of all hypotheses between the specific and general boundaries that remain consistent with the examples.

concepts.name: candidateElimination
concepts.description: The learning procedure that removes inconsistent hypotheses as positive and negative examples are processed.

concepts.name: configuration
concepts.description: A snapshot of the current training examples and the hypothesis boundaries.

assertions.name: candidateEliminationPreservesConsistency
assertions.description: The version space contains only hypotheses that agree with every example seen so far.

assertions.name: goodVersionSpace
assertions.description: When the specific and general boundaries converge, the remaining version space identifies the intended concept.
